lines: Completion of first-year requirements with no failures, including 3.0 courses with a minimum average of 60%:

3.0 courses (with no more than 1.0 course in any one discipline) from: English 2038E, English 2470F/G, English 3774E, English 3775E, First Nations Studies 2218F/G, French 2410E, French 3720F/G, French 3721F/G, Geography and Environment 2010A/B, History 2201E, History 3201E, History 3205E, History 3209E, History 4201E, History 4701E, History 4705E, Political Science 2222E, Political Science 2230E, Political Science 2270E, Social Work 2280E, Sociology 2232, Sociology 2239, the former Canadian Studies 3300E, the former Economics 3315E, the former First Nations Studies 2217F/G, the former Geography 2012A/B, the former Political Science 3333E, the former Political Science 3338E, the former Social Justice and Peace Studies 3300F.
